notes.title: Seasons, Hunting, Cooking and more added to New Frontier 🏕️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! [i]OMO: New Frontier[/i] Devlog #5 is live over on YouTube.

[b]This update covers a range of new features including:[/b]
[list]
[*]Weather effects and seasons
[*]Building complex, multi-step structures (like a Cabin!)
[*]Cooking with the Mess Kit item
[*]Bow hunting and trapping
[*]A new menu interface, and more!
[/list]

Plus, we were able to build some key features that are [i]not[/i] shown in the devlog—but which are just as important—like game saving, character select, and level management. 


[previewyoutube=qiI10gy2njI;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Let me know what you think of the devlog. 
Thanks for watching! 🌄

- Kyle

notes.content:
